scope: Final retained evaluator-only source-readiness study design, inactive after frozen retrieval calibration failed. No new-member membership seal, source acquisition or clinical-label execution is authorized.

windows.source_access_audit: Present-day retrieval kept separate from historical evaluator availability; preserve actual UTC transport times, regardless of local report date.

activation_gates.requirement: Frozen positive controls recover expected original protocol/SAP and original report identity through direct approved routes, with readable original content, hashes, document/version identity and explicit failures. Control-source substitutions are forbidden. Access success alone is not scientific qualification.

Frozen exact-trial discovery controls recover the designated original-document identities through bounded structured-reference and quoted-NCT routes. Preserve raw query tool arguments/returns and exact query correspondence. A generic or unrelated search representation fails calibration; no silent broad-search fallback. Root must seal numeric controls, expected identity sets and pass criteria before controls run.

Independently verify complete January2025 candidate, row/version, ranking, planned-maturity, source/code and old/new exclusion closure. Seal exact12 membership, source-only packets, query templates, caps and this protocol before new-member source retrieval.

calibration_failure: Retain attempted controls and failure. Do not start new-member retrieval if G1/G2 fail. A revised transport/search route needs a prospective versioned amendment and a fresh bounded control attempt; no substitute broad search or favorable-control deletion.

sampling.frame: Existing128 origin-screened candidates from the frozen endpoint-origin design;36 maturity-eligible, of which12 already followed up.
sampling.algorithm: From the original frozen candidate list in its original deterministic rank, retain January2025 maturity-eligible members, exclude every member of the original12 pack and every member of the already-followed-up new12 pack, then take the first12. Validate exact remaining count24 and no duplicates. Do not rehash/reorder, filter by document availability or inspect new-member follow-up before membership sealing.
sampling.membership_status: Unsealed and inactive. G3 origin closure was not performed; no final cohort membership is represented or authorized by this design.
sampling.criteria: Retain all inherited origin eligibility, raw planned-completion precision, prospective scientific holds and endpoint-local cautions. Safety-primary, descriptive or unclear objectives remain in fixed denominator. Planned completion is a sampling stratum, never a decision occurrence.
sampling.insufficient_pool: Explicit stop with preserved failure; no relaxed dates, replacement, new candidates or source-available enrichment.
sampling.exposure: Known origin pipeline exposure and prior128 metadata processing. Excluding earlier24 members does not establish model-training absence, unseen holdout, independence or public preregistration.

route_order: Inspect already sealed January2025 registry-provided document references without fetching follow-up records.
Resolve exact-trial original protocol/SAP references through approved official registry/investigator/sponsor or publisher routes.
Use at most three literal quoted-NCT targeted searches: protocol/SAP; primary results/designated analysis; formal analysis or decision date.
retrieval.query_validation: Log and verify exact quoted canonical NCT token in tool arguments and returned search provenance; unrelated generic returns are discovery failure, never evidence of no documents. No target/drug-only fallback or full-registry search.
retrieval.documents: Each substantively distinct original artifact/version/correction counts, including downloaded temporally rejected artifacts. Do not merge several artifacts to evade caps. Supplement package of the same original counts with its parent and preserves all file hashes. Shared artifacts count against every informed trial and once in unique global count.
retrieval.structured_routes: Direct original-document attempts consume document budget on successful original retention but not a search-query slot. Freeze attempted-route count/retry/timeout/size limits in the executable acquisition manifest before dispatch; do not leave unbounded retries or recursive link crawling.
retrieval.stop: At three targeted queries or three retained original artifacts per trial, stop its corresponding route and record missingness. No paid access, sign-in requests, outreach, unbounded citation expansion or automatic retry of failed transport.
retrieval.source_identity: Exact NCT token is necessary for canonical trial binding where applicable, not sufficient for regimen, arm, population, objective or analysis scope. Authoritative explicit trial-to-protocol identifier linkage can qualify identity even when the document uses a sponsor protocol ID; retain the bridge. Wrong arm, parent trial or other population must remain unqualified.
retrieval.access_failures: Record HTTP403/404/429, robots/access denials, parser failures, empty or unrelated search returns, redirects, unknown dates and unavailable originals separately. Do not equate access failure with nonexistence or absence of a clinical decision.

readiness_components.requirement: Endpoint-local evidence that the selected primary efficacy objective lacked an already-achieved definitive decision at origin. Prior higher-phase elsewhere is not a blanket efficacy exclusion. Unknown remains unknown.

Explicit bridge among frozen selected NCT, experimental regimen/arm, comparator, population and primary objective, with authentic amendment/version linkage. Identify monotherapy controls, combination regimens, parent/extension designs and population discrepancies; do not transfer outcomes.

Authentic prespecified primary efficacy criterion, designated analysis, endpoint/comparator/population, missingness/intercurrent handling, multiplicity and interim/final structure where applicable. Document authenticity and evidence rule preceded analysis/unblinding. Patient response, secondary significance, power/alpha or stage1 continuation alone is not a final success algorithm.

Source-linked formal analysis/decision interval, separated from observation, data cutoff, completion and public disclosure. Only wholly supported interval inside(origin,horizon] qualifies temporal readiness; unknown precision/boundary timezone held.

Exact source version demonstrably publicly available by ascertainment; retrieval now, internal PDF date or current download header alone insufficient. Authentic preanalysis rule made public after origin can be evaluator-only when public by ascertainment. Later information remains contemporary audit-only, excluded from historical readiness.

Describe bounded search/document coverage, parser and access gaps. Selected-trial evidence cannot qualify complete same-program history, first-dose negatives or no-decision through horizon. No such endpoint labels are assigned.

measurements.transport: Trials with a readable identity-qualified original /12; report document counts, failed routes and parser limits separately.
measurements.scientific_components: Each supported readiness component /12, retaining partial, inapplicable, unknown and held cases in all-member denominator. Joint readiness requires every applicable mandatory component including origin risk and historical source availability; primary-safety/undefined cases cannot be joint efficacy-ready.
measurements.joint_readiness: Joint qualifying source package /12; not an efficacy label, event incidence, positive predictive value, clinical probability or scientific truth.
measurements.present_day_vs_historical: Report contemporary source recovery and historical evaluator readiness as distinct yields, never one pooled measure.
measurements.statistics: Counts and explicit denominators only; no population CI, power, model performance, training prevalence or sample-independence claim from this purposive exposed source-feasibility sample.

review.design: Two AI source reviewers independently record component dispositions with exact original locators and date/version/scope qualifications; withhold the other current ratings until sealed, preserve disagreements and reconciliation. Shared origin metadata and known controls disclosed. Technical verifier checks source receipts, identities, caps, member order and null-label invariants.
review.limits: AI review and agreement are not independent biological truth or human domain validation. Authenticity, temporal proof and scientific scope cannot be established from agreement alone.

outputs: Membership freeze and complete exclusion/order provenance
Per-attempt search/transport receipt, exact arguments, failures and hashes
Per-trial source-readiness component records with original-row/document locators
Distinct present-day and historical readiness yields
Independent source/receipt/membership checks and retained reconciliation
Stop/go assessment for a separately authorized scientific adjudication phase; no automatic expansion or training

stop_go.go: Only if calibration passes and origin closure/membership are sealed may bounded new-member source readiness run. Completion of source-readiness does not activate clinical labeling or fitting.
stop_go.no_go: Zero joint readiness, unresolved authenticity/scope/timing or poor retrieval calibration are valid feasibility outcomes. Retain nulls and report bottlenecks; no retrospective rule relaxation.
stop_go.later: Any fullclinical adjudication, additional cohort, historical predictor construction, genetics/MR/scoring, competitor run, T2-T5 or H6 extension requires its own unchanged or newly frozen method and is outside this phase.

limitations: No externally registered protocol or protected clinical holdout.
Public route discovery is bounded and cannot prove global nonexistence.
No fresh database access or Internet source research was performed in drafting this proposal.
The scientific protocol is retained inactive, not a public preregistration or protected holdout.
G1/G2A passed only on known exposed controls. G2B failed despite exact-NCT hits; this is not a calibrated discovery-sensitivity estimate for new trials.
No G3 independent origin closure, final membership seal or new-member source-readiness review was executed in this phase.

calibration.g3_disposition: not_performed; membership remains null and proposed origin closure has not activated

discovery.route: Exact registry study result with frozen same-NCT current structured-document projection; contemporary discovery only.

discovery.reason: No qualifying discovery chain to the frozen Taiho WCLC original; different ESMO report and non-frozen Cullinan host cannot substitute for the expected original identity.

calibration.meaning: Direct transport of known originals and current registry-reference projection passed. Exact identifiers alone did not discover the required second expected original through the frozen discovery route. This is an engineering discovery calibration failure, not evidence that the source or any clinical event does not exist.

conditional_caps: The retained12-member/36-query/36-document design is conditional only. No allowance is activated. Before any future acquisition, prospectively amend and validate the failed route, seal fresh bounded controls/pass criteria, pass all gate conjunctions, verify origin closure and seal membership. Preserve this failed calibration and all original design/source records.

final_disposition.decision: Stop new-member source-readiness acquisition at the failed G2B discovery gate.
final_disposition.completion_scope: The retrieval-control feasibility assessment and inactive scientific study design may be reported complete; the proposed12-member source-readiness study itself has not run.
final_disposition.required_next_work: Prospectively design a versioned correction to exact-original discovery and test it against preserved expected originals and explicit additional controls before activating a cohort. No automatic rerun, broader search fallback, favorable-control substitution, document-availability sampling, weakened criterion or newer historical evidence substitution.
final_disposition.scientific_boundary: All clinical labels stay unassigned/null, probabilities null, numerical features empty, clinical activation false. No training, genetics/MR/scoring, outcome adjudication, comparator run, T2-T5/H6 or live framework model invocation.
